description: Read and write Asana tasks, projects, sections, comments, tags, teams and users on app.asana.com in your current tab. List and search tasks, create/update/complete/delete tasks, add followers, manage projects and sections, comment on tasks, and list workspaces, users, tags and teams. Uses your own logged-in Asana session.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific task by its GID.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in a workspace. Optionally assign to a project, user, or parent task.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update an existing task — change name, completion status, assignee, dates, or notes.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task by its GID. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search for tasks in a workspace. Supports filtering by text, assignee, completion status, due dates, and projects.

tools.name: get_tasks_for_project
tools.description: List tasks in a project. Supports pagination with limit and offset.

tools.name: get_tasks_for_section
tools.description: List tasks in a project section. Supports pagination with limit and offset.

tools.name: get_subtasks
tools.description: List subtasks of a parent task. Supports pagination with limit and offset.

tools.name: add_followers
tools.description: Add followers to a task. Followers receive notifications about task activity.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects in a workspace. Returns projects sorted by name with optional filtering by archived status. Supports pagination via offset.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific project by its GID.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project in a workspace. Requires a workspace GID and project name. Optionally set notes, color, team, dates, and visibility.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update an existing project. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List all sections in a project. Sections are used to organize tasks into groups within a project.

tools.name: create_section
tools.description: Create a new section in a project. Sections organize tasks into groups.

tools.name: add_task_to_section
tools.description: Add a task to a specific section. The task will appear at the top of the section. A task can only be in one section of a given project at a time.

tools.name: get_stories_for_task
tools.description: List stories (comments and activity) on a task.

tools.name: create_story
tools.description: Add a comment to a task.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated Asana user, including their workspaces.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Asana user by their GID.

tools.name: list_users_for_workspace
tools.description: List all users in a workspace.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List all workspaces the current user has access to.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tags in a workspace.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List all teams in a workspace.
